top_signals.title: Oil Swings With Focus on Deep Saudi Price Cut
top_signals.summary:
Oil fluctuated in jittery trading, as Saudi Arabia cut prices of its benchmark grade to Asia, the kingdom’s state producer warned about the risk of low stockpiles and as fighting in Yemen intensified.
Martijn Rats, Global Commodities Strategist at Morgan Stanley, discusses upside oil risks amid broader Middle East fighting. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iraq Seeks More Tankers to Control Its Hormuz Oil Transits
top_signals.summary: Iraq is set to hire additional tankers, with at least two arriving over the next few days as the country looks for greater control over moving its oil through the heavily contested Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: MacGyver at Scale: Winning Future Air Wars of Rapid Technological Adaptation
top_signals.summary:

Some helicopters were shot down, and the rest were forced to suspend flight operations, meaning the island bases were cut off from each other and from easy resupply. top_signals.title: Everybody's Business: Tubi's Growth Strategy Includes Edgy Merch
top_signals.summary:
At a time when subscriber growth is slowing for streaming giants like Netflix, ad-supported online video services like Tubi are seizing the opportunity, offering viewers abundant content without the cost of a subscription.

Tubi’s Chief Content Officer Adam Lewinson joins Max Chafkin and Stacey Vanek Smith on the Everybody's Business podcast to discuss the company's strategy, including cultivating niche genres like horror and offering free, edgy merchandise to capture the Gen Z audience. (Source: Bloomberg)
